scenes.heading: DSH-SUPERAGENT RUNS YOUR REPO
scenes.say: Could an agent run your repo without you watching it?

scenes.heading: A PROACTIVE AGENT
scenes.say: It's dsh-superagent, a research prototype published by DeepSeek: a proactive coding agent for one repository.

scenes.heading: IT TAKES THE WORK
scenes.say: It listens to GitHub, and optionally Feishu. When someone asks for work, it opens a work item in its own session.

scenes.heading: ANSWERS IN THE THREAD
scenes.say: It answers in the thread where the work was asked, often with a pull request, and a panel shows what needs a person.

scenes.heading: ONLY WHEN ASKED
scenes.say: It acts only when asked, or when a team rule allows it. Your coding agent walks you through setup.

scenes.heading: THE CATCH
scenes.say: The catch: it's research code, not a DeepSeek product, and some designs in the paper are not in it.

idea: dsh-superagent is a DeepSeek research prototype: a proactive coding agent that watches one repo and answers in the thread.

claims.text: dsh-superagent is a proactive coding agent for one GitHub repository, packaged as a bundle for DeepSeek Harness.
It listens to GitHub and, optionally, Feishu; a request for work opens a work item that runs in its own session and directory.
It answers in the original conversation, for example with a pull request, and a web panel shows what needs a person.
It acts only when asked or when a team-written rule allows it, and setup is walked through by your own coding agent from SETUP.md.
